name: LivePlaylist
author: LivePlaylist contributors
description: Builds a Navidrome playlist from setlists for gigs you attended

library.reason: Match setlist songs against music in selected libraries

matcher.reason: Match setlist songs to tracks in the Navidrome library

scheduler.reason: Sync the playlist at startup and at the configured interval

subsonicapi.reason: Search the user's library for matching recording versions and create or update the live setlist playlist

users.reason: Run library matching and playlist updates for the configured Navidrome user

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh attended setlists and update playlists (scheduled at 03:00 server time)

users.title: User configurations
users.description: Each user has their own setlist.fm API key, gig list, and playlist

username.title: Navidrome username
username.description: Must be granted to this plugin in Navidrome's user access settings

playlistName.title: Playlist name
playlistName.description: Existing playlist with this name is extended; defaults to Live Setlists

importMode.title: Gig source
importMode.description: Choose whether this user enters gigs manually or imports attended setlists from a setlist.fm profile

liveVersionPreference.title: Live recording preference
liveVersionPreference.description: When matching a song, prefer live recordings, avoid live recordings, or use Navidrome's default match

minimumTrackLengthSeconds.title: Minimum track length (seconds)
minimumTrackLengthSeconds.description: Tracks shorter than this are excluded from the playlist; set to 0 to disable the filter

setlistUserId.title: setlist.fm profile user ID
setlistUserId.description: Required in profile mode; ignored in manual mode

gigs.title: Gigs attended
gigs.description: Required in manual mode; ignored in profile mode
